notes.title: The Aurora Update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32859104/f2bd90eb1d05aa32916de5010d061f5e9b9b63d3.png[/img]

Hello Strivers!

We are pleased to announce that our first update is now live, featuring several improvements, specially some focusing on helping newcomers to get into Westgrim and Strive!

You can read all the patch notes in our blog [url=https://blog.playstrive.com/2018-06-20-the-aurora-update-is-here/]by clicking here[/url].

Hope you enjoy!

See you on Westgrim!

notes.title: Strive is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32859104/707e7da874ba295d2d4a443f28029521c6df14f9.png[/img]

We're proud to announce that Strive is now available on Steam!

To celebrate this moment, we're giving you all a [b]discount of 20%[/b] to help you get started with Strive.

Don't forget to tell your friends about the news. Though we haven't released the party mode yet, lots of practice will be required when the time comes--and the best opportunity to exercise is now.

Last but not least, don't hesitate to communicate us about any bugs you may face. Our team will measure no effort to get them fixed as soon as possible.

See you on Westgrim!

notes.title: Our official blog is live!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We are proud to announce that the official Strive blog is finally live!

After restless days working on it, we've finally come to something solid to release to the public.

[url=https://blog.playstrive.com/]Click here to access it![/url]

To know more about it, read our introduction post [url=https://blog.playstrive.com/2018-06-13-introducing-the-official-blog/]by clicking here.[/url]
